description: The pie chart represents the distribution of narrative media framing in political discourse across three different years: 2017, 2018, and an unspecified year. There are three slices in the chart, each corresponding to one of the years. The largest slice, representing 2018, is colored blue and accounts for 46% of the chart. The second largest slice, representing 2017, is colored green and makes up 33% of the chart. The smallest slice, representing an unspecified year, is colored orange and constitutes 21% of the chart. Each slice is labeled with both the year and the corresponding percentage. The chart does not include a legend, and the percentages are displayed inside the slices. The slices are not visually emphasized in any particular way.
